text: Councillor’s office is in receipt of a petition, where 68 percent of residents are in favour of the below turn restriction, to address cut-through traffic during afternoon peak hours.

City Council on November 13 and 14, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound left turns from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday (bicycles excepted), at the intersection of Kingston Road and Audrey Avenue.
